admission_dependencies.description: Deferred to governance; no authorization implied.

assumptions.standing_basis: Stipulated synthetic definition; no external corroboration asserted.

candidate.proposition: A declared integer domain can be partitioned into four typed outcomes.

constructive_pole.minimal_model: Three disjoint integer ranges and a complement of the integer domain.

predicted_consequences: Exactly one classification applies to each input.

failure_surfaces.explanation: The mathematical domain and host language types may disagree.

destructive_pole.statement: Ambiguous integer typing can make the classifier overlap.

collapse_requirement.acquisition_or_design_obligation: Downstream formal review must bind definitions.
collapse_requirement.against_minus: A proof removes the alleged overlap in the stated domain.
collapse_requirement.against_plus: An input satisfies two outcome predicates.
collapse_requirement.alternative_space: Incomplete coverage could defeat both narratives.
collapse_requirement.blindness_declaration: Not applicable to this synthetic formal example.

ABSTAIN.condition: Input is an integer less than zero.

FAIL.condition: Input is an integer greater than zero.

INVALID.condition: Input is not an integer; booleans are excluded from integers.

PASS.condition: Input is an integer equal to zero.

collapse_requirement.confounder_declaration: Host language boolean/integer coercion must be excluded.
collapse_requirement.expected_under_plus: A proof of all intersections empty.
collapse_requirement.observable_metric: Proof obligations for typed domain coverage.
collapse_requirement.operational_definition: Check all six intersections and union coverage.
collapse_requirement.question: Do the predicates partition the declared domain?
collapse_requirement.scope_and_limits: A toy mathematical classifier; no physical claims.

discrimination_vector.separation_description: Need proof relative to an explicit integer definition.
